title: UmbraSpotlightOrderParameters
description: Order parameters for the umbra_spotlight product. These do not constrain the search results; they define general properties of the entire order, such as how and where the collected data is delivered.

deliveryFormat.title: Delivery Format
deliveryFormat.description: The file format in which the collected products are delivered.

deliveryConfigId.title: Delivery Config ID
deliveryConfigId.description: Identifier of a preconfigured delivery location to push products to upon collection. If null, products are only made available for download.

priority.title: Tasking Priority
priority.description: The priority tier used when scheduling the collect.

customerReference.title: Customer Reference
customerReference.description: Free-text client-side reference attached to the order and its invoice.
